groups.defect: AssignmentSource freezes queued at import time, transports a raw datetime that reportedly fails JSON serialization, and does not restore the datetime type when deserialization produces a string.
groups.rationale: The timestamp-default reports overlap with the serialization-failure report through s_30f59a75 and s_7123f91d. The latter also shares the deserialization type problem with s_ad4d76d9, connecting all members while requiring the merged comment to preserve three defects.
